title: indigo_agent_scheduler: rename the IDLE_PARK_AFTER setting to IDLE_HOOK_DELAY and list the hooks in pairs

outcome.summary: One documentation defect: indigo_docs/INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:828 still lists the hook priority texts in the old order (hook startup, hook shutdown, hook idle, hook night start, hook night end, hook resume); the owner's note asks the guide to list the hooks in the new order, and line 861 of the same guide was already updated. Change it to hook startup, hook shutdown, hook night start, hook night end, hook idle, hook resume. Everything else is correct: git grep finds no IDLE_PARK_AFTER or old macro outside .factory2/archive; SETTINGS and HOOKS index defines match the init order; run_kind enum, hook_names[] (only array indexed by run_kind) and plan_hook_name() switch match; run_kind is only compared by equality, never by range, persisted or sent to clients; hook_kind() precedence change (NIGHT_START/NIGHT_END now before IDLE) is documented in the guide (line 643) and SCHEDULER.md (line 579); PROPERTIES.md, PROPERTY_MANIPULATION.md, SCHEDULER.md, guide hooks table and property table updated; tests and scheduler_sandbox.py address items by name; DRIVER_VERSION 0x0300001E; define alignment preserved; git diff --check clean; no README.md changed. Tests: scheduler unit binaries header/sky/plan/night all passed; integration test_agent_scheduler 134 run, 134 passed, 0 failed.

Re-review of eb31ce29f..8a6d21658: only three documentation lines changed, INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md:641 and :828 and SCHEDULER.md:702; each now lists the hook priority texts as startup, shutdown, night start, night end, idle, resume. The earlier finding is resolved. A grep of the tree outside .factory2 and the PDFs finds no documentation list of all six hooks still in the old order. The only remaining old-order sequence is a by-name dict that clears all hooks in indigo_test/integration/run_scheduler_simulators.py:502; it does not depend on item order, so it is not a defect. git diff --check is clean. Earlier verification still holds: the unit binaries passed and test_agent_scheduler ran 134 cases with 134 passed. Only documentation changed since that run, and flow check passed on f993d2c8.
